description: Unit test class for ImmutableJsonLong, testing its immutability, equality, conversions, and type checks within the org.eclipse.ditto.json package.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonLongTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ImmutableJsonLong class, including nested parameterized tests for various long values.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonLongTest.ParameterizedTests
classes.description: Parameterized nested class that runs tests on ImmutableJsonLong instances initialized with different long values.

methods.name: doubleValues
methods.description: Provides a collection of long values (extremes, zero, and a sample value) for parameterized testing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ImmutableJsonLong instance before each test with the current test parameter.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableJsonLong is immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hash code contract of ImmutableJsonLong using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: jsonLongEqualsJsonIntIfSameValue
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableJsonLong treats equal to ImmutableJsonInt with the same numeric value.

methods.name: jsonLongHasSameHashCodeAsJsonIntIfSameValue
methods.description: Validates that ImmutableJsonLong and ImmutableJsonInt with the same value produce the same hash code.

methods.name: jsonLongEqualsJsonDoubleIfSameValue
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableJsonLong treats equal to ImmutableJsonDouble with the same numeric value.

methods.name: jsonLongHasSameHashCodeAsJsonDoubleIfSameValue
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableJsonLong and ImmutableJsonDouble with the same value produce the same hash code.

methods.name: getValueReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that getValue() returns the initialized long value.

methods.name: asLongReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that asLong() returns the initialized long value.

methods.name: asDoubleReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that asDouble() returns the initialized long value.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that toString() returns the string representation of the long value.

methods.name: isNotNull
methods.description: Verifies that the value is not null.

methods.name: isNotBoolean
methods.description: Verifies that the value is not a boolean.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks that the value is identified as a number.

methods.name: isIntReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks if isInt() correctly reflects whether the long value is within Integer range.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Verifies that isLong() returns true.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Verifies that isDouble() returns true.

methods.name: isNotString
methods.description: Verifies that the value is not a string.

methods.name: isNotObject
methods.description: Verifies that the value is not an object.

methods.name: isNotArray
methods.description: Verifies that the value is not an array.

methods.name: tryToGetAsBoolean
methods.description: Tests that calling asBoolean() throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: getAsIntBehavesCorrectly
methods.description: Tests that asInt() returns the correct int value or throws if out of range.

methods.name: tryToGetAsString
methods.description: Tests that calling asString() throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: tryToGetAsObject
methods.description: Tests that calling asObject() throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: tryToGetAsArray
methods.description: Tests that calling asArray() throws UnsupportedOperationException.
